# Retry

Retry is an AI-assisted revenue recovery system for failed Razorpay payments.

Website: https://retry-buildathon.vercel.app/
Judge demo: https://retry-testing.vercel.app/
Agent overview: https://retry-buildathon.vercel.app/agents.md
GitHub: https://github.com/hemanthreddykoduru/Retry

Retry verifies Razorpay webhooks, applies deterministic recovery-safety rules,
and uses Sarvam AI only for eligible multilingual customer conversations.
It never collects OTPs, UPI PINs, CVVs, card details, passwords, or bank credentials.
